title: Kalman Delta Networks: Uncertainty-aware Associative Memory
abstract: arXiv:2609.07816v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Linear attention is increasingly used in frontier language models for efficient long-context inference and constant-memory decoding. Its fixed-size recurrent memory, however, requires an online decision at each token: what to write and how strongly to overwrite existing associations before knowing which information future queries will require. Delta-rule models learn this strength from the current token embedding but do not track confidence in the memory estimate, preventing each write from adapting to accumulated evidence. To represent this uncertainty explicitly, we reformulate recurrent associative memory as a linear--Gaussian state-space model, for which the Kalman filter is the optimal recursive estimator, and introduce a new family of models, Kalman Delta Networks (KDNs). Within KDNs, the transition propagates both the memory state and its uncertainty, allowing the Kalman gain to weight each residual write by accumulated evidence

translated_title: 卡尔曼增量网络：不确定性感知的联想记忆
translated_abstract: 线性注意力因其在高效长上下文推理和恒定内存解码方面的优势，越来越多地应用于前沿语言模型中。然而，其固定大小的循环记忆需要在每个token处做出在线决策：在尚不知道未来查询需要哪些信息的情况下，决定写入什么内容以及以多强的力度覆盖现有关联。增量规则（Delta-rule）模型从当前token嵌入中学习这一写入强度，但不追踪记忆估计的置信度，导致每次写入无法根据积累的证据进行自适应调整。为了显式地表示这种不确定性，我们将循环联想记忆重新表述为线性-高斯状态空间模型（卡尔曼滤波器是其最优递归估计器），并由此引入了一类新的模型族——卡尔曼增量网络。在KDN中，状态转移同时传播记忆状态及其不确定性，使得卡尔曼增益能够根据积累的证据对每次残差写入进行加权。
tldr: 该论文提出卡尔曼增量网络（KDNs），将循环联想记忆重新表述为线性-高斯状态空间模型，利用卡尔曼滤波同时传播记忆状态及其不确定性，使每次记忆写入的强度能够根据积累的证据进行自适应调节。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Kalman Delta Networks (KDNs), which reformulate recurrent associative memory as a linear-Gaussian state-space model, propagating both the memory state and its uncertainty so that the Kalman gain adaptively weights each write by accumulated evidence.
